labels.macBody: This is equivalent to entering your username and password on this Mac: it can access the same media libraries and record your viewing progress. Only approve the pairing code shown on the Mac in front of you.
labels.memberTitle: Access: The same permissions as you
labels.memberBody: The program on this machine can act as you and do everything you can do on the website, including all capabilities the administrator has granted you. Only approve if you know what program is running on this machine.
labels.adminTitle: Access: The same full access as you
labels.adminBody: The program on this machine can do everything you can do on the website, including deleting media files. Only approve if you know what program is running on this machine.
labels.manualTranscodeBody: A program holding this token can only claim and run transcoding jobs. It cannot view or change your subscriptions, media library or settings. The token does not expire automatically and can only be revoked here.
labels.manualFullBody: A program holding this token can do everything you can do on the website, including deleting media files. The token does not expire automatically and can only be revoked here. Store it only on machines you control.
labels.revokeCli: The command line on this machine will lose access immediately. Run mclaw login again to pair and regain access.
labels.revokeWorker: This transcoder will disconnect immediately and stop active transcodes. Pair it again in the transcoder to regain access.
labels.revokeManual: Programs holding this token will lose access immediately. The token cannot be restored; create a new one to regain access.
labels.revokeJellyfin: This player will sign out immediately and stop active playback. Sign in again in the player to regain access.
labels.revokePaired: This device will lose access immediately. Pair it again to regain access.
labels.revokeLogin: This device will sign out immediately and stop active playback. Enter the password again to sign in.

proxy.envHint: Use the proxy from HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY or other environment variables
proxy.manualHint: Enter a proxy address directly; supports HTTP and SOCKS5
proxy.invalid: The address must start with http://, socks5:// or socks5h://
proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.immediate: Changes take effect immediately. No restart is needed.
proxy.noEnvHint: No HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY or ALL_PROXY was detected. For Docker, pass -e HTTPS_PROXY=… or select “Manual” and enter the address.
proxy.servicesHint: Choose which services use the proxy above. Downloaders and media servers on the local network always connect directly and are not listed here.
proxy.unavailable: No proxy is available, so these switches are disabled. Tests remain available and check direct or mirror connectivity.
proxy.defaults: Recommended defaults route TMDB, image sources and Fanart.tv through the proxy because they are blocked within China. Direct access is usually faster for Douban and PT sites, and some PT sites check the outgoing IP. Enable a proxy as needed. “Test” sends a real request using the current settings; a successful test immediately restores a service whose circuit breaker is open.
proxy.sitesHint: Control each configured site separately. Direct access is usually faster for PT sites within China, and some sites check the outgoing IP. Only enable a proxy for sites that need it.
proxy.indexHint: Download Python packages for third-party plugins from this index. If direct PyPI access is unreliable within China, use the Tsinghua mirror.
proxy.invalidHttp: Must start with http:// or https://
proxy.mirrorsAlternative: An alternative to using a proxy
proxy.apiHint: Replaces api.themoviedb.org for discovery, search and subscription setup. /3 is added if you enter only a domain. Leave blank to use the default.
proxy.imageHint: Replaces image.tmdb.org for posters and backdrops. /t/p is added if you enter only a domain. Leave blank to use the default.
proxy.addressHint: The HTTP or SOCKS5 inbound address of Clash, sing-box or another proxy. Use socks5h:// to resolve domains through the proxy and avoid DNS poisoning.{empty, select, yes { Changes are saved and applied after you enter an address.} other {}}
proxy.mirrorExplanation: There are two independent ways to reach TMDB: a proxy changes the network route while keeping the destination, and a mirror replaces the official destination with a directly reachable reverse proxy. Choose either if possible. If both are configured, requests go through the proxy to the mirror. Mirrors may be self-hosted with nginx or Cloudflare Workers, or public. Public mirrors can see your API key.

external.changeTitle: Change the listening port from {currentPort} to {targetPort}?
external.restarting: The listening port has changed to {port}. Restarting the app…
external.restartDocker: For Docker port mappings (bridge networking), also change the container-side port in your Compose ports mapping to {port} and recreate the container. For host networking or a direct installation, use the new port directly.
external.portOverview: The app listens on this port; the default is {defaultPort}. Saving triggers a full restart, after which you must use the new port.
external.dockerHelp: With Docker port mappings (bridge networking), this changes the container-side port. Update ports in Compose as well or the app will become unreachable. It is usually simpler to change only the host-side mapping, such as 8096:3000, without changing this setting.
external.hostHelp: This setting is mainly for host networking or direct installations, where the container port is the host port. Use it to avoid a port conflict.
external.envHelp: You can also set MOVIECLAW_WEB_PORT at deployment time. The setting here takes priority.
external.rejected: The previous port {rejectedPort} could not be bound, usually because it was occupied. That setting was discarded and the app fell back to {currentPort}.
external.confirmRestart: The app will restart fully. Then use the new address {url}.
external.mappedWarning: You are accessing port {seenPort}, while the app listens on {currentPort}, so a port mapping or reverse proxy is in between. Changing this setting breaks that route unless you also update the mapping or proxy target to {targetPort}. For Docker, change the right-hand side of ports in Compose and recreate the container. If you only want a different access port, change the left-hand side of the mapping instead.
external.dockerWarning: For Docker port mappings (bridge networking), also change the container-side port in Compose to {targetPort} and recreate the container. Otherwise the app will become unreachable after restarting, and you will need to edit Compose to recover. Host networking and direct installations need no extra changes.
